what: Turn one logo letter into a disc and lay a thick hand over it, and the hand ticks like a clock by 30° every 750ms with no in-between values (one full turn takes 9s). Each time the hand returns to 12 o’clock, the disc color changes to the next one — yellow → green → red → blue → orange … For quizzes, timers, a coming-soon feel wordmark and quiz button icons

options.colors: List of circle colors to switch on each lap (comma-separated) — default var(--kf-accent), var(--kf-success), var(--kf-danger), var(--fx-tick-blue, var(--kf-ink)), var(--kf-warning)
options.[data-fx-part=disc]: Color-changing circle — fill for an SVG shape, background color for HTML. The needle’s axis is at this circle’s center
options.[data-fx-part=hand]: Rotating needle — painted in the text color (currentColor)

note: In the original, every logo on screen (header, footer, quiz button) ticks together from one variable on the document root, and the big Hero logo stops at 12 o’clock or spins depending on the scroll scene. The part spins per attached element, so attach them at the same time to keep the tempo aligned. It stops in hidden tabs.
use: <svg data-fx="tick-hand-logo" viewBox="0 0 100 100"><circle data-fx-part="disc" cx="50" cy="50" r="40"/><rect data-fx-part="hand" x="45" y="4" width="10" height="34" rx="3"/></svg>

from.where: shared.js logo (original common.js data-logo-loop — every 750ms --logo-q-rotate +30°, every 360° --logo-q-color cycles through nine colors: yellow, green, red, blue, orange, sky, pink, lemon, lime)
